# Round Robin Sports Algo

> Daily MLB Quick Hits: the steadiest plays on the board, where our bats stack up, and a team call when a lineup is loaded. Every call is graded the next morning, regular season and postseason tracked separately.

## Quick Hits record (graded vs official box scores; live and backtest never mixed)
- Postseason, live: free picks 1 of 2 (50%); members card 1 of 2 (50%); 2026-09-30 to 2026-09-30
- Postseason, backtest: free picks 4 of 4 (100%); members card 6 of 6 (100%); 2026-09-29 to 2026-09-29
- Regular season, backtest: free picks 499 of 692 (72.1%); members card 876 of 1382 (63.4%); 2026-03-29 to 2026-09-27
Backtest = generated after the fact by a walk-forward replay using only pre-game data; not published on those dates.

## About
Daily MLB Quick Hits in Early, Midday and Night editions, posted as each window's lineups lock, plus a morning recap
grading every call. Regular season and postseason are tracked separately.
